what_it_does: Trent Limited operates a retail business selling apparel, footwear, beauty products, accessories, and food/grocery items directly to consumers through physical stores and online channels under various brands like Westside, Zudio, and Star, making money through direct retail sales.
other_facts: Trent operates a network of over twelve hundred/1,250 stores.
Zudio had 963 stores across 310 cities in India and 3 locations in the UAE as of March 2026.
Star serves customers through a network of approximately 2,000 farmers directly or through consolidators.
